scope: Supplier Create/Download feedback and bundled event-handler regression
reportedIssue: User reports unable to download after clicking Create; exact user status and whether button is disabled remain unconfirmed.
changes: Display password validation and encryption failure beside Create
Preserve invalid inputs for correction and retain an existing downloadable backup when validation fails
Report missing browser WebCrypto without exposing raw errors

checks: Invalid password length and mismatched passwords produce adjacent feedback
Completed encryption enables Download without exposing the generated key
Missing browser WebCrypto keeps Download disabled and gives adjacent feedback
Lock during encryption prevents late completion from enabling Download

limitations: Node VM with a minimal DOM harness; not a real browser execution or download test.
Disposable test inputs only; user password, key and backup were not accessed.
Original empty-state browser evidence predates this change.
No claim that the user-reported root cause is confirmed.
